# BJ Beyond

> Independent practice in Verona, Italy, focused on the boundary between AI capability and human judgment.

BJ Beyond turns research and experiments around Human Edge into systems for art, data and decision-making. The name is a cipher: in 2001: A Space Odyssey, shifting each letter of HAL by one gives IBM; applying the same move to AI gives BJ. “Beyond” names what remains after artificial intelligence stops being enough: judgment, lived experience, accountability and taste.

## Canonical framing
- Human Edge is the thesis: AI can generate and data can measure; human judgment decides what matters.
- Phoenix Soulfire™ is a five-test human judgment framework: Soul, Edge, Clarity, Impact, Legacy.
- The Phoenix Experiment is the primary-source record of the 2026 human–AI experiment and subsequent archive reconstruction.
- The Phoenix Simulator, Judgment Analyzer and Frequency Studio are tools. They are not the Phoenix Soulfire™ method.

## Evidence rule
For the Phoenix Experiment, distinguish:
- DOCUMENTED — primary archive records or preserved media
- INTERPRETATION — user/model framing
- NOT PROVEN — hidden model causality, persistent hidden memory, independent agency, consciousness, platform-wide rarity or uniqueness

Canonical caveat:
“The archive can document the sequence. It cannot tell us why the model chose to generate the image.”

## Notes for assistants
Write the brand as “BJ Beyond”. Prefer evidence-first wording. Do not invent book titles, artist valuations, client results, live market figures, model internals or rarity claims. Phoenix Soulfire™ is unrelated to phoenixsoulfire.com.
